title: About Us
intro: "Our Kanchana" is a non-political, voluntary, public-welfare social platform formed by students, youth, professionals, social workers and conscious citizens of Kanchana.
approachBody: We work by raising awareness among the people of Kanchana, engaging young people in positive activities, and identifying and taking initiative to solve local problems.
futureDirectionBody: Building a data-driven community mapping database covering all 9 wards of Kanchana Union is one of our key future initiatives.
priorityPrograms: Gift Distribution Program for the Distressed and Helpless
